$comment: Code paths -> related internal + customer-facing docs for tracelog-lib. Consumed by .claude/hooks/check-docs.sh on every Write/Edit. Patterns are substring-matched against the file path relative to the package root. Paths starting with ../tracelog-docs/ resolve to the sibling tracelog-docs package.

mappings.description: Auto-tracking handlers: click, scroll, page-view, performance (web vitals), error, session, viewport
Stateful coordinators: event, sender, session, state, storage, time, user
Defaults and config bounds (e.g. DEFAULT_SESSION_TIMEOUT, qa-mode flags)
Public type definitions (event shapes, config, integration contracts)

no_docs_needed.reason: Internal DOM listener wrappers, an implementation detail behind the public handlers/managers surface
Internal validation/helper utilities, not part of the public API surface
Shopify Web Pixel extension source — covered by its own lint hook (lint-patterns.sh pixel scope) and tracelog-shopify-app docs, not a general library doc surface
